product_overview: LABURO is a mobile-first staff hiring app for event operators to find, hire, and manage temporary crew end-to-end in one place. It also lets staff apply, onboard, manage their profile, and respond to offers through a magic link without creating an account.
core_goals: Log into the operator portal and manage staffing workflows from a central dashboard
Create gigs and search the candidate pool by role and availability
Review candidate profiles and send paid offers to selected staff
Allow staff to apply, onboard, and update their profile
Let staff accept or decline offers through a public magic link
Track staff check-in for event-day time tracking

features.name: Operator Login
features.description: Operators sign into the internal portal with email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error message

features.name: Operator Dashboard and Portal Navigation
features.description: Operators view an overview and move between the main portal sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View the overview data -> Move to other portal sections through navigation -> See the selected section load
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the calendar section -> Open the payments section -> Open the wallet section -> Open the messages section -> Open the notifications section -> Open the settings section

features.name: Create Gig
features.description: Operators create a new event gig with its staffing details.
user_flows: Navigate to /tablero/nuevo -> Enter gig role, dates, pay, and location -> Optionally mark the gig as a HITO event -> Submit the form -> See the new gig appear on the board

features.name: Search Candidate Pool
features.description: Operators search and filter candidates to find suitable staff for a gig.
user_flows: Navigate to /buscar -> Enter a search term -> Apply role and availability filters -> Review matching candidates -> Open a candidate profile from the results

features.name: Send Offer to Candidate
features.description: Operators create and send a paid offer to a candidate from their profile.
user_flows: Navigate to /staff -> Open a candidate profile -> Open the offer flow -> Enter offer pay and dates -> Submit the offer -> See the offer status update to sent

features.name: Public Offer Accept/Decline (Magic Link)
features.description: Staff open a tokenized offer page, review the offer, and accept or decline it without an account.
user_flows: Open /o/[token] -> Read the offer details -> Accept the offer -> See a confirmation of acceptance
Open /o/[token] -> Read the offer details -> Decline the offer -> See a confirmation of decline

features.name: Public Staff Registration
features.description: Prospective staff submit the public join-us form to enter the candidate pool.
user_flows: Navigate to /sumate -> Fill in personal details and role or availability information -> Submit the registration form -> See a confirmation message

features.name: Staff Onboarding and Profile
features.description: Staff complete onboarding, edit their profile, and access their staff panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding-staff -> Complete the onboarding steps -> Continue to the staff area -> See the staff panel
Navigate to /editar-perfil-staff -> Update profile information -> Save the changes -> See the updated staff panel

features.name: Staff Check-in (Fichaje)
features.description: Staff clock in for an assigned gig on event day.
user_flows: Navigate to /fichaje -> Open the check-in screen -> Confirm check-in for the assigned gig -> See the check-in acknowledged

known_limitations.issue: Running against a Next.js dev server (npm run dev), which is single-threaded; TestSprite caps frontend tests at 15 to avoid overloading it
known_limitations.impact: Fewer tests per run; some concurrent flows may be flaky. Production build (npm run build && npm run start) would raise the cap to 30.

known_limitations.issue: No test account credentials were provided during configuration
known_limitations.location: Testing Configuration (Test Account Info left empty)
known_limitations.impact: Authenticated operator/staff screens may not be reachable past login; deep portal flows may be limited to the login gate.
